whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Gravity Fitness Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.2★ reviews from 310+ members in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gravity

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Gravity Fitness Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Gravity Fitness Gym in Mithapur, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your strong 4.2-star reviews. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
